strings.en: Still, I'm surprised one of the Gyandlar's top brass came in person.
I don't care to aid some mercenary's operation either, but...
But Lord Gades ordered it. All because these fools are useless!
...What, it's our fault again?
Try bein' the ones out front every single time, I swear.
Got something to say!?
N-Nothin' at all, Big Sis.
Don't call me Big Sis! ...So, Globine,
you want to fight Rom's friend Blue Jet, don't you?
Indeed. Rom Stol is formidable as well... but as a swordsman,
I must settle things with that Blue Jet!
I see... I owe Rom and his friends a thing or two myself,
from before I came to this Earth. I'll lend you a hand this time.
My duel with Jet is a contest between swordsmen... Do not interfere!
Heh heh heh... I know what your kind are likely to say.
I just thought I'd set the stage for you.
Set the stage...?
Listen. There's a meteor cluster at this point. Wait there.
I'll lure them out nicely for you.
After that, do with them as you please...
...Very well. Devil Saturn, all of you, make ready!
You got it!
(...Even if Globine fails, if things are as Lord Gades said...
Heh heh heh...)
Oleana... how foolish. For planet Campbell's colonization plan,
she slipped into Earth thousands of years ago, yet struggles this much.
Quite so, Brother. But now that we're here,
wiping out the Earthlings will be child's play!
Gwah ha ha ha ha!
Warukimedes! Dangel!
Oh!? Lady Janera!
Our Empress, Lady Janera. You look radiant as ever...
Spare me the greetings. You both understand, I trust.
The Earth colonization plan can no longer be left to Oleana.
I shall take command personally.
As you say. With us brothers and our enhanced Magma Beasts...
we shall surely wipe out the humans!
But... we were ordered not to tell Oleana about us...
Don't you see, Dangel? Lady Janera has already abandoned Oleana.
Unaware of our arrival, Oleana's forces will make the perfect decoy.
As expected of Warukimedes. You understand my thinking well.
Then you surely know what must be done first...?
Of course.
Our scouts report a very complicated war being waged around Earth...
Even I know that much.
So, exploiting this chaos, as our first foothold
we will seize this space fortress, which they seem to have abandoned!
Precisely.
Using the derelict fortress the humans call the Gate of Zedan,
we shall first scatter the Earthlings!
Yes, Your Majesty!
Brother, leave that task to me!
When it comes to battle, I, Dangel, am second to none!
Very well, Dangel.
As my brother, live up to Lady Janera's expectations!
I'm counting on you, Dangel...
Make a bloody example of the humans, and make Earth
the domain of us Campbellians!!
Yes, Your Majesty, without fail!
PLS Black Point... There again?
What is it, Captain?
No... From that asteroid where we picked up the Cyber Beast Force,
I'm getting a faint energy reading.
An energy reading? ...So there was somethin' there after all.
I knew it was fishy.
We got jumped by unidentified robots, so of course something's there.
Shouldn't we say it's started moving, rather?
What the hell, you guys! Talkin' like you know it all!
We've defended Konpeito. Is that our next stop, Captain?
No... there are other places with strange activity as well.
Strange activity...?
Where?
At a meteor cluster fairly close by, unidentified units
are reportedly gathering.
They don't seem to be moving yet, but there's no telling what they'll do.
Captain Bright, what about that thing Prospector told us earlier?
Did something come up from the Nadesico?
Yes... It's information from Nergal rather than the Nadesico,
but an abandoned unmanned colony the Colony Corporation was moving...
has reportedly disappeared.
Recovering a colony in the middle of all this? What are they thinking...?
Nah, times like these are when you can get away with all sorts of stuff.
Back in my junk dealer days, those were the times I got fired up.
There's no accounting for taste. And that's how it turned out...
But what does it mean that the information came from Nergal?
It takes a snake to know a snake's path, then...
Jeez, this stinks.
Anyway, a whole colony going missing is way too unnatural.
All of these are pretty close by... What do you think?
Isn't that a little unnatural?
There may be decoys mixed in to draw our attention. But...
We don't know which is the real one, and with multiple enemy forces...
they could all be operations by separate factions.
There was that time they tested a mobile armor in a derelict colony.
Yeah... Not knowing for sure is the worst.
Mobile armor tests were done in a derelict colony once before.
Maybe we'd better check it out.
We'll just have to check 'em one by one.
The Colony Corporation in particular... something about it bugs me...
What? What's with calling us all together so suddenly?
Can't even get a decent rest.
But an emergency muster... Is it the enemy!?
Correct. ...The Gate of Zedan is under attack by an unknown enemy.
Unknown enemy... Don't tell me it's that bony thing again!?
Bones...? Londo Bell even fights ghosts?
It was in Londo Bell's combat records.
A mysterious force they fought on the moon. Mysterious, as usual.
No... it seems to be a new alien force of a type we've never encountered.
Another new enemy... What on Earth is it about Earth?
Gate of Zedan...? There's a giant gate floating in space?
There's no up or down in space, so why'd you need a gate?
No, silly, it's the name of a space fortress.
It used to be called A Baoa Qu.
...But I heard that with the military cutbacks,
it doesn't function as a base anymore...
Then maybe we can ignore it for now...
We can't. Places usable as bases are already few...
If any more are crushed, it'll affect the battles ahead.
So basically we've gotta defend it, right? Man, we're way shorthanded.
We've got the Nadesico and the Aestivalis team too. It'll be fine!
Captain Yurika's right. No grumbling, no grumbling.
Now that it's decided, let's hurry, Captain.
Yeah, let's beat 'em fast and check those fishy colonies on the way back.
Great idea. The Gandor Team's giving it their all at Jaburo, right?
We've gotta show what we're made of too.
Yeah. ...But I wonder how the Gandor Team is doing?
It'll be a busy fight... but there's no other way.
The Gandor Team... Koji and the rest must be fighting at Jaburo.
We can't afford to whine.
That Gandor Team... how are they doing now?
Bright, what's the deal?
The Gandor Team... has abandoned the assault on Jaburo.
Huh!?
What the hell!? Old man Hazuki was so fired up, and now this!?
...I don't know why. There was one transmission, then silence...
It said they'd abandoned the assault on Jaburo,
and were returning to Japan for now.
I wonder if they ran into some trouble. Getting so close, and then...
Dr. Hazuki was always a careful teacher. He must have his reasons.
Japan... Could the laboratories have been attacked again?
It's possible.
I hope everyone's all right...
Nothing's going right, huh?
...But we don't really have time for this, do we?
Agreed. Even if the Gandor Team is in trouble...
it's not like we can rush right over.
...We'll just have to trust them.
That's right! Dr. Hazuki... I mean, Commander Hazuki will be fine!
I took his lectures, so I can vouch for him!
...That's not a reason.
Looks like old man Hazuki picked up a fan in a weird place.
Tetsuya...
...Koji.
They'll manage just fine.
All right, the Ra Cailum will now...
Emergency message! Londo Bell, please respond! Londo Bell!
...Kou!
That voice... Nina!?
Open a channel!
This is Anaheim Electronics... Nina Purpleton!
Nina! What's wrong? Why the panic!?
Kou... it's terrible! The Vega Star Federation... at Von Braun...!
...So, the Aestivalis team should get ready for an emergency launch too!
Akito, I'm counting on you!
I thought we were going to the Gate of Zedan, but it's Von Braun!
Seriously, just how many enemy forces are there?
...The Jovian Lizards, the Vega Star Federation, the aliens at Zedan...
and there's Neo Zeon too... Ahhh, I've lost track!
Quit yappin' and get on standby already!
It's a fight either way! All Aestivalis 0G Frames,
prepare to launch!
Ready whenever you are! Don't you dare break 'em!
Damn straight! No matter how many enemies stand in my way, I'll beat 'em!
...Huh?
What's wrong, Yamada... I mean, Gai?
...Where the heck is Von Braun, anyway?
Ruri... too much heckling ruins the comedy...
...Is that so.
(So it's... comedy.)
To explain, Von Braun City is a lunar city that hosts factories
of Anaheim Electronics, the arms company famed for
its mobile suit development.
The Zeta Gundam, the Gundam GP01, and GP02 were all built there.
We've no intention of easily falling behind Anaheim, but
Nergal's still a newcomer... We can't claim Earth means Nergal yet.
Oh? But Sasebo means Nergal, doesn't it?
No, no, the scale is...
